# SessionException

common

class [SessionException](index.html)(message: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), cause: [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html)? = null) : [RuntimeException](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/lang/RuntimeException.html)

Thrown when a [SessionService](../-session-service/index.html) operation fails. A caller that needs to act on one particular failure matches [message](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-exception/--root--.html) against the constants declared here, so this stays one type rather than a hierarchy.
